# Kiplinger

> Trusted personal finance and business forecasting resource providing expert guidance on investing, retirement planning, taxes, and wealth management since 1920.

Kiplinger delivers actionable financial advice for investors, retirees, and wealth builders, covering everything from tax-efficient investment strategies and retirement income planning to estate planning, fraud prevention, and market analysis. The site serves both individual investors and financial professionals with research-backed insights on building and protecting wealth.

## Key Topics

- Retirement Planning
- Tax Planning & Strategy
- Wealth Management
- Financial Planning
- Investment Strategy
- Estate Planning
- Retirement Tax Reduction
- Portfolio Diversification
- Tax-Efficient Investing
- Financial Adviser Selection
- Asset Allocation
- Special Needs Planning
- Fraud & Scam Prevention
- Market Analysis
- Self-Directed IRAs

## Retirement Planning & Strategy

- [Hiring a Financial Adviser: How to Sort the Best From the Rest](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/financial-adviser-how-to-sort-the-best-from-the-rest): Kelli Kiemle's guide to selecting the right financial adviser
- [Longevity and Asset Allocation: Rethinking Stock-Bond Splits](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/longevity-and-asset-allocation-rules-stock-bond-split): Feroz Ansari on rethinking asset allocation for longer retirements
- [The Best Retirement Advice of All Time](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/the-best-retirement-advice-of-all-time): Expert compilation of top retirement wisdom from investing greats
- [We're 62 and Plan to Sell Our $1.2 Million House to Retire, but Our Daughter and Grandkids Live With Us](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/were-62-and-plan-to-sell-our-usd1-2-million-house-to-retire-but-our-grandkids-live-with-us-my-wife-says-we-should-stay-im-ready-to-ask-them-to-move): Retirement downsizing advice for multigenerational living situation
- [I'm 62 With $1.5M Saved, but My Wife's Shopping Is Derailing Our Retirement](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/were-in-our-60s-with-usd1-5-million-im-worried-my-wifes-shopping-habit-is-going-to-derail-our-retirement): Advice on managing spousal spending conflicts in retirement planning
- [Do Your Financial Adviser's Fees Reflect Value or Growth?](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/retirement-planning/flat-fees-for-financial-advice-value-vs-portfolio-growth): Dr. Preston Cherry on flat fees vs. AUM-based adviser compensation

## Tax Planning & Strategies

- [65 or Older? 5 Tax Strategies to Protect Your Retirement Income](https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/ways-to-save-on-taxes-if-youre-65-or-older): Senior tax strategies including bonus deductions and Roth conversions
- [How Retirees in the 2% Club Can Reduce Their Lifetime Taxes](https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/tax-planning/reducing-lifetime-taxes-for-retirees-in-two-percent-club): Tax strategy for retirees with pensions to avoid IRMAA and reduce taxes
- [You May Still Be Able to Defer Your 2025 Capital Gains](https://www.kiplinger.com/taxes/tax-planning/defer-2025-capital-gains-qualified-opportunity-fund-qof): Qualified Opportunity Fund strategy for deferring 2025 capital gains

## Estate Planning & Wealth Transfer

- [This Is How a QTIP Trust Protects Your Kids' Inheritance](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/inheritance/how-a-qtip-trust-protects-your-kids-inheritance): QTIP Trust strategy for blended families and inheritance protection
- [Special Needs Planning: A Road Map for Long-Term Security](https://www.kiplinger.com/retirement/estate-planning/special-needs-planning-a-practical-guide): Mindy Neira's guide to financial planning for special needs families

## Fraud Prevention & Consumer Protection

- [Is That Really Your Grandkid Calling, or Scammers Using AI?](https://www.kiplinger.com/personal-finance/is-that-your-grandkid-calling-or-an-ai-scam): AI voice-cloning scams targeting seniors and fraud prevention tips
- [Investing Scams: How to Protect Yourself and Your Money](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/investing-scams-how-to-protect-yourself-and-your-money): Investor protection guide covering common scams and prevention tactics
